topic: Which measure of food waste answers the question?
grammarFocus: 学术论证的限定、因果、对比与证据范围
title: Which measure of food waste answers the question?
instructions: 原创学术微训练；场景、机构与数值均为虚构模拟，不是事实报道或官方试题。先独立阅读答题，再用原句核对限定、比较与因果。短篇专项不能替代完整陌生测评。
passage:
A. A fictional college cafeteria introduced smaller default portions at lunch. Students could request a second serving without an additional charge. After four weeks, the kitchen reported a reduction in food waste from ninety kilograms to seventy. The headline suggested a clear improvement, but the catering manager asked what had been weighed and how many meals had been served.

B. The weighing station collected food left on returned plates. It did not include unsold meals or vegetable peelings produced during preparation. The figures therefore described plate waste, rather than every form of discarded food. Meanwhile, lunch attendance fell during an examination week. Dividing the total by the number of meals gave a smaller improvement than comparing the totals alone. Both results were arithmetically correct, but they answered different questions.

C. The second-serving rule created another practical issue. A queue formed near the kitchen entrance, and some students with short breaks did not return for more. The manager was unwilling to assume that every empty plate indicated satisfaction. She asked a small group about portion size and the time needed to obtain additional food. Several liked the smaller serving; others said they had left hungry because they could not wait.

D. Kitchen staff proposed putting the second-serving station beside the exit. Before making a permanent change, they ran a two-day trial and recorded the queue length. The shorter queue was encouraging, but those two days had unusually low attendance. A busier trial would be needed before estimating the space required during a normal week.

E. The final evaluation combined waste per meal, total plate waste and comments about access to sufficient food. It avoided claiming that a single measure captured the whole outcome. The manager also retained a record of what the scales excluded. If another college wished to compare results, it would need the same definition of waste and a comparable counting method. A precise label could be as important as an impressive reduction.

grammar.title: 区分让步与原因
grammar.explanation: although 表示“虽然”，because 表示“因为”；按两句的实际关系选词，不按相邻位置猜。

questions.evidence: Although the trial was small, its records were complete.
